blocks.content: The CVC was initially created by an executive resolution in 1964 based on the recommendations of the Santhanam Committee on Prevention of Corruption. It was later given statutory status in 2003 to strengthen its independence.

rows: Prevention of corruption based on Santhanam Committee report

items: Crucial distinction: CVC was NOT a statutory body in 1964; it was created by an executive resolution.
Always link the establishment of CVC to the Santhanam Committee on Prevention of Corruption.
Year 2003 marks the transition of CVC into a statutory body.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The CVC was established in 1964 by an executive resolution.
The formation was based on recommendations by the Santhanam Committee on Prevention of Corruption.
Statutory status was granted to the CVC in 2003 to enhance its independence.
